comment: SDK 27 arm64 unions must occupy inline storage, not an unsafe.Pointer. Native Clang probes give es_process_t.reserved size 16/alignment 1 at offset 212, and es_event_bootstrap_look_up_t.target size 56/alignment 8 at offset 64. Equivalent C arrays preserve those layouts; the former has exactly one anonymous field. Acceptance layout tests guard these SDK-specific corrections.
